moon_sidecar.source: release moon from the laya installer
moon_sidecar.extra_flag: --disk-free-min-pct 1 (via LAYA_MOON_BIN wrapper; the data volume was ~96% full and Moon's default 5% floor paused writes, failing every query)

arms.laya-lex: same hooks + MCP with LAYA_BUDGET_MS=0: lexical-only ranking, no Laya model

scoring: LAYA_MEMO=0 (every prompt scored cold); daemon restarted at each run start; arms interleaved per task in random order (seed 7)

moon.tasks: bench/tasks-v8/moon.jsonl (= v7 bench/tasks.jsonl; reproduced by `tasks --skip 40 --n 20` at this commit, which is the checkout v7 ran on)

leakage: none of moon/httpx/hono is in finetune/repos.py TRAIN (codex, velos, PraisonAI, pi-mono, ai-guard, python-dependency-injector, dispatch, ai-proxy); moon is HELDOUT. The train checkouts are not on this machine, so the root-commit overlap check could not be re-run; the laya-base pre-training corpus and Sonnet's pre-training may include httpx/hono (public, popular).

sessions.dropped_reason: moon laya-arm sessions whose every prompt injection failed (Moon disk-full guard); archived in moon/runs.dropped.jsonl and re-run once, all succeeded

spend.pilot: 18 sessions (2 tasks x 3 arms x 3 repos), $5.19, 16.6 min; projected full run $52 / 2.8 h (gate: $150 / 16 h); pilot rows are part of the final 180
